changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'QuestionOption') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[QuestionOption]( [QuestionID] [int] NOT NULL, [QuestionTypeOptionID] [int] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_QuestionOption] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [QuestionID] ASC, [QuestionTypeOptionID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_QuestionOption_Question') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[QuestionOption] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_QuestionOption_Question] FOREIGN KEY([QuestionID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Question] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[QuestionOption] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_QuestionOption_Question] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_QuestionOption_QuestionTypeOption') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[QuestionOption] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_QuestionOption_QuestionTypeOption] FOREIGN KEY([QuestionTypeOptionID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[QuestionTypeOption] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[QuestionOption] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_QuestionOption_QuestionTypeOption] END
